channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
channel.desc: Nigel Slater raids his cupboards, fridge and vegetable patch to create a week's worth of delicious meals. He demonstrates how to make ingredients go just that little bit further. Whether it's adding grated beetroot to make a tasty meatball supper feed the masses or putting the spotlight on a small garden harvest to make a sensuous pudding, Nigel's clever tricks and inspired ideas demonstrate that bountiful feasts can be made with few ingredients.
